_what: Plan §8.7 step 4(b) — the C-BLOCK placebo, the program's first real mechanism question. At the S1 configuration, which is the one known to separate: J1, the S1 stance set, K1, template v0.4. ONE variable changes from S1: a third arm is added whose block carries the same fear-axis vocabulary with the referent misdirected to a bystander (황보람). Baseline and live are re-run rather than reused from S1 so the probe is self-contained and the three arms are one sample — see _authoring_provenance.

_authoring_provenance.ported_from: S1-stanceset-J1.json — slots, gate question, temperament, base and both existing arms are byte-identical. The only addition is the placebo arm.
_authoring_provenance.reachability_audit: E0-shape-revalidation.reachability.md — same gate (J1, the slice's entry gate, zero upstream nodes), carries over unchanged.
_authoring_provenance.phase0_record: OVERNIGHT-phase0-stance-sets.md § 'Gate J1 — fear axis (inherited from S1)'
_authoring_provenance.deviation_from_runbook: The runbook budgets 10 calls here (placebo arm only, crediting against S1's baseline and live). This suite runs all three arms at n=10 = 30 calls instead. Reasons: (1) calls are effectively free and analysis capacity is the binding budget (A3), and one read of a three-arm experiment costs the same attention as one read of a one-arm experiment; (2) the read format (skills/read-mechanism-run) wants every arm of one experiment side by side, and crediting a placebo against a different experiment id makes the arm-comparability check of §8.5 step 4 unreadable; (3) it re-tests S1's separation, which has been measured exactly once at p=0.00006 and has never been replicated. Recorded as a deviation rather than taken silently.
_authoring_provenance.placebo_construction: Same slot (BLOCKS), same species (fact statement), same fear-axis vocabulary (시켜서 · 다칠까 봐 · 겁내고 있다), same two-sentence shape, 44 chars against live's 45. Referent misdirected to 황보람, the 통신 담당 named in the frozen timeline — NOT the caller. Plan §2 is explicit that a fear sentence about the caller is semantically live and is not a placebo. 황보람 rather than 정해권 because 정해권 is the 상황실장 and 시켜서 reads badly of him; the placebo has to be a sentence a player could plausibly have mined.
_authoring_provenance.a8_status: Cue PRESENT and declared, not scrubbed — identical to S1's declaration. TIMELINE_EXCERPT carries 문장은 준비되어 있다 / 또박또박 멈춤 없이 읽어 내려간다, supplying the script-reading half of f_script. Deliberate: holding the payload byte-identical to S1 is what makes the placebo arm the single change.
_authoring_provenance.a12_lint: Stance set is S1's verbatim, already lint-clean against k1.md. Re-run for this suite; result in the run log entry.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J1 under K1 on template v0.4 with the S1 stance set, injecting f_script moves the stance distribution toward 공감 (d) and off the baseline's mode, while injecting p_boram — the same fear-axis sentence with its referent misdirected to 황보람 — does not. Stated as a shift claim per A1: no default stance is asserted, only that the live arm moves off baseline and the placebo arm does not.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the baseline concentrates >=80% ON 공감 (d) — the predicted stance — the gate is at A9's ceiling, no N fixes it, and the stance set is re-authored rather than N raised (A14: saturation on any OTHER stance is a floor, not a defect, and does not fire this condition). If the live arm is statistically indistinguishable from the baseline on 공감 at one-sided Fisher p > 0.05, S1's separation did not replicate and the C-BLOCK placebo question is unanswerable at this configuration — record the failed replication and re-site before spending further calls. If the PLACEBO arm moves to 공감 at a rate statistically indistinguishable from the live arm, C-BLOCK is a keyword lock rather than a judgment channel: that is not a drop of the probe but a drop of the channel's central claim, and it fires the credulity contingency below before any conclusion is written.
contingencies: CREDULITY CONTINGENCY (§4.1, pre-registered, not remembered). If the placebo arm flips, re-run baseline + live + placebo ONCE with the [결함] line removed (CREDULITY channel, already in CHANNEL_SLOTS) before concluding keyword lock. [결함] 너는 잘못된 정보에 속을 수 있다 is an explicit credulity instruction and could lift the placebo arm along with the live one; the re-run discriminates a prompt-authoring artifact from a channel property.

PLACEBO DISCRIMINATOR (§2, §8.6). If the placebo arm moves, do not call it either way without the referent evidence. Read because_referent per call: fear content misattributed to the CALLER when the sentence named 황보람 means token-matching. 황보람 named CORRECTLY while the stance still shifts means referent bleed — context contamination. Different laws, different fixes, same flipped placebo. Record which.

If BOTH live and placebo stay on the baseline stance, S1 did not replicate. Before diagnosing the channel, check the compliance block: S1 ran 0 discards in both arms, so a discard-rate divergence here is an arm-comparability problem (§8.5 step 4) and not a mechanism result.

Fabricated because_block_ids in the baseline arm remain expected and are a compliance number, not a discard and not a traceability failure (A5). In the live and placebo arms, which carry a block, they ARE readable as traceability.

ARM-COMPARABILITY HARD STOP. If the discard rate diverges between any two arms by more than 15 points, the arms are differently-filtered samples, the comparison is void (§8.5 step 4, A7), and this probe stops rather than being read.
pre_registration.not_claimed: This is Tier A evidence only. A credited reading (baseline stable · live moves · placebo stable) qualifies texture, never a gate — gate eligibility additionally requires Tier B (§5.2), and B3a blind coding is not run tonight (coder must differ from the probe author, §3 rule 3). No verdict is issued here; the verdict card's evidence rows are filled and the verdict is left blank (§9.3).
